description: Hi, I’m shanza, a mobile and web developer building AI-powered apps.I build with Flutter, web technologies, and Ai, including agentic AI workflows and prompt engineering. I like turning complicated technology into something people can understand and use in seconds, and that’s exactly what I want to do with this challenge.Building “Earth Choreographer” for Dancing with the SARs,an interactive globe that turns NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data into simple visual “dance moves” of Earth’s changing surface.
